"""Underline all headlines in the unpacked quarterly_report.docx.

Headlines are the report's short all-caps section titles (e.g.
"EXECUTIVE SUMMARY", "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS"). For each headline paragraph
we add <w:u w:val="single"/> to the run-properties of its text runs in
word/document.xml, preserving the original file encoding and formatting.
"""
import html
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main'
DOC = Path('quarterly_report_unpacked/word/document.xml')


def is_headline(text):
    t = (text or '').strip()
    if not t or len(t) > 60:
        return False
    if not re.search(r'[A-Z]', t) or re.search(r'[a-z]', t):
        return False
    if re.search(r'[^\x20-\x7E]', t):  # no bullets/arrows/box-drawing, etc.
        return False
    return True


def paragraph_text(p):
    return ''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter('{%s}t' % W))


def main():
    raw = DOC.read_bytes()
    for enc in ('ascii', 'utf-8'):
        try:
            content = raw.decode(enc)
            break
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    else:
        sys.exit('ERROR: could not decode document.xml')
    nl = '\r\n' if '\r\n' in content else ('\r' if '\r' in content else '\n')
    lines = content.split(nl)

    text_re = re.compile(r'<w:t(?:\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</w:t>')
    insertions = []  # (line index before </w:rPr>, indentation string)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        m = text_re.search(line)
        if not m or not is_headline(html.unescape(m.group(1))):
            continue
        j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and lines[j].strip() != '</w:rPr>':
            j -= 1
        if j < 0:
            sys.exit('ERROR: no run properties above headline at line %d' % (i + 1))
        indent = ' ' * 10
        k = j - 1
        while k >= 0 and lines[k].strip() != '<w:rPr>':
            ls = lines[k].strip()
            if ls.startswith('<') and not ls.startswith('</'):
                indent = lines[k][:len(lines[k]) - len(lines[k].lstrip())]
                break
            k -= 1
        insertions.append((j, indent))

    for j, indent in sorted(insertions, key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True):
        lines.insert(j, indent + '<w:u w:val="single"/>')
    DOC.write_bytes(nl.join(lines).encode(enc))

    # Validate: re-parse and check every headline paragraph is underlined
    tree = ET.parse(DOC)
    root = tree.getroot()
    paras = [p for p in root.iter('{%s}p' % W)]
    headlines = [p for p in paras if is_headline(paragraph_text(p))]
    underlined = [p for p in paras
                  if p.find('.//{%s}rPr/{%s}u' % (W, W)) is not None]
    if set(id(p) for p in headlines) != set(id(p) for p in underlined):
        sys.exit('ERROR: underlined paragraph set != headline paragraph set')
    print('Underlined %d headline(s) in word/document.xml:' % len(headlines))
    for p in headlines:
        print('  - %s' % paragraph_text(p).strip())
    print('Validation OK: exactly the headline paragraphs carry w:u.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    t = (text or '').strip()

    xml = z.read('word/document.xml')

root = ET.fromstring(xml)
paras = [p for p in root.iter('{%s}p' % W)]

for p in headlines:
    print('  - %s' % ''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter('{%s}t' % W)).strip())
print('No other runs carry underline; document.xml is well-formed.')
